arguments.command:
cd /workspace && for f in examples/*.in.json; do
  python3 -B submission/main.py < $f > /tmp/r1.json 2>/dev/null
  python3 -B submission/main.py < $f > /tmp/r2.json 2>/dev/null
  python3 -c "
import sys
a=open('/tmp/r1.json','rb').read(); b=open('/tmp/r2.json','rb').read()
print('DETERMINISTIC' if a==b else 'NONDET', '$(basename $f)')
"
done
